title: Local console access
responsibility: Supplies local history files and the cached access guard used by the reports server.

outputs.name: consoleDirectory
outputs.description: The absolute path returned by resolve for the trimmed HARNESS_CONSOLE_DATA value, or undefined when that value is unset or blank. It selects the directory for console history reads but is not checked for existence.

outputs.name: consoleData
outputs.description: An object with async json(path) and media(name) methods that read JSON text and media bytes beneath the resolved console directory; missing, unreadable, and out-of-directory file reads resolve undefined. For a matching revisions/<40-lowercase-hex>.json path, json can derive missing source measurements from that commit only when HARNESS_SITE_ROOT is nonblank and measurements are available; resolved-root/commit observations are cached with at most four entries.

outputs.name: consoleServer
outputs.description: Returns the module-cached ConsoleAccess object with guard, entry, json, and media handlers backed by consoleData. On first call, it captures HARNESS_OWNER_MODE, HARNESS_BIND (falling back to HOST), and ADDRESS_HEADER; its policy admits only explicit loopback owner mode, a loopback bind address, no nonblank address-header setting, and a loopback peer, and a policy exception denies the request.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: A nonempty malformed JSON string from a matching revisions/<40-hex>.json path rejects consoleData.json; a nonempty malformed index.json rejects the returned ConsoleAccess.entry handler while it parses data for canonical routing.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A valid revision JSON document with a null root fails when selectedRevision reads commit, and index JSON without the arrays expected by canonical routing can fail as consoleCanonical traverses them.
